mentions.name: Easy-search
mentions.description: A keyboard-driven TUI application for quickly searching files on Linux. Users define zones where they most often search for files, manage a history of previously accessed files, and perform actions on each file or folder found.
mentions.problem: The author needed an equivalent of voidtool's Everything file search tool on Linux.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Easy-search - https://github.com/BlueInt32/easy-search

TUI based interface to search in your files very quickly. I created it from the need to have an equivalent of voidtool's Everything on Linux.
